first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: longitudinal main road
entities.identification: A road extending into the distance between buildings, with lane markings, arrows, and intersection cross stripes visible.

entities.name: group of hanging signs
entities.identification: Rectangular horizontal signs spanning above the road or extending from the roadside over it, separate from the illuminated signs along the street.

entities.name: group of buildings in the near view
entities.identification: Relatively near dark gray, beige, and pinkish-brown buildings on both sides of the road, with rows of windows, projecting balconies, and terraces visible.

entities.name: distant high-rise skyline
entities.identification: Dense high-rise buildings of varying heights behind the group of buildings in the near view, with colored window lights, vertical light strips, and dome-shaped illuminated tops.

entities.name: foreground elevated roadway
entities.identification: The bridge deck extending diagonally across the lower-right part of the frame, with adjacent traffic areas for opposite directions and guardrails along the roadway.

entities.name: tree canopy beside the elevated roadway
entities.identification: A contiguous area of dark green tree canopy behind the elevated roadway and in front of the light pink low-rise building on the right.

entities.name: Vehicle G
entities.identification: A box truck in the near-side lane of the elevated roadway, with a turquoise cab, a blue rectangular cargo box, and a light pink cargo-box roof, its front facing toward the lower left of the frame.

entities.name: building facades along the street
entities.identification: Narrow facades arranged along the longitudinal main road, including walls, windows, horizontal lines between floors, and projecting elements, excluding freestanding signs and pedestrians.

entities.name: illuminated signs along the street
entities.identification: Vertical and horizontal illuminated signs and signs with red-and-white circular patterns on both sides of the street, excluding the separately listed group of hanging signs.

entities.name: group of pedestrians on the left sidewalk
entities.identification: Multiple small-scale pedestrians beside the intersection and storefronts on the left side of the road, excluding Person C and any other separately listed persons.

entities.name: roadside sidewalk
entities.identification: The long, narrow pedestrian pavement between the outer edge of the lane on the left side of the longitudinal main road and the building facades along the street.

entities.name: roadside metal guardrail
entities.identification: A low guardrail of thin bars along the lane-side edge of the sidewalk at the intersection.

entities.name: night sky
entities.identification: The dark blue area of sky visible above the high-rises and in the background between the buildings.

entities.name: metal guardrail of the elevated roadway
entities.identification: Gray bar-like guardrails extending along the outer edges of the elevated roadway deck and between the traffic areas for opposite directions.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: A single dark-clothed person on the road surface in the lower center of frame 0, to the right of the group of pedestrians on the left sidewalk, with another cyan-blue human figure to the right.
